recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-34530 unless a later work group decision changes the semantics of QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire or the GCS example canonical URL.
issue_request: FHIR-34530 was a Published FHIR-core QuestionnaireAnswers/QuestionnaireResponse change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to correct the Glasgow Coma Score QuestionnaireResponse example so QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire uses the canonical URL of the Questionnaire instead of the example id/reference, and to clarify the QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire short description as "Canonical URL of Questionnaire being answered".
initial_application: The example canonical URL was already fixed before Jira application: git commit 5efb2c01a0 changed source/questionnaireresponse/questionnaireresponse-example-gcs.xml from Questionnaire/gcs to http://hl7.org/fhir/Questionnaire/gcs. The Jira-tagged application commit 65026343c3 changed source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml from "Form being answered" to "Canonical URL of Questionnaire being answered".
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists questionnaire and questionnaireresponse as active resources, so the inspected files are in current build scope. The current Questionnaire GCS example declares url http://hl7.org/fhir/Questionnaire/gcs, and the current QuestionnaireResponse GCS example uses the same canonical. Zulip discussion before Jira filing confirms that the relative Questionnaire/gcs value was the reported problem, and Confluence FHIR SDC minutes for 2022-03-03 record FHIR-34530 as Persuasive with Modification. No conflicting community evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active GCS QuestionnaireResponse example already uses the canonical Questionnaire URL, and QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire already has the requested short description.
